title: Wise Business - Multi-currency cross-border accounts at near mid-market FX rates
clean_text: Wise Business offers multi-currency accounts that hold 48 currencies with local account details in 11 currencies (including USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, SGD), automatable via API, targeting small and medium-sized businesses as well as large corporations needing cross-border payments at rates close to the mid-market rate without requiring a traditional bank. Wise Business customers grew 26% year-over-year to 572,000, with business transaction volumes up 35%, contributing to a 25% rise in overall cross-border volume to £181.7 billion. Wise has expanded its direct network access, including Japan's Zengin clearing system in 2024 and new Mexico remittance services in early 2025.

meta.target: SMBs to large corporations needing cross-border payments
